description: This file contains unit tests for the DataSourcePerTenantServiceFactory class, which is responsible for creating and configuring data sources for tenants in the Fineract platform. It uses Mockito to mock dependencies and verifies the behavior of data source creation under different modes and configurations.

classes.name: DataSourcePerTenantServiceFactoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of the DataSourcePerTenantServiceFactory for creating data sources based on tenant configurations and modes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and sets up default behaviors before each test case.

methods.name: testCreateNewDataSourceFor_ShouldUseNormalConfiguration_WhenInAllMode
methods.description: Verifies data source creation with default mode settings.

methods.name: testCreateNewDataSourceFor_ShouldOverridesMinPoolConfiguration_WhenConfigured
methods.description: Checks if minPoolSize configuration overrides default.

methods.name: testCreateNewDataSourceFor_ShouldOverridesMaxPoolConfiguration_WhenConfigured
methods.description: Checks if maxPoolSize configuration overrides default.

methods.name: testCreateNewDataSourceFor_ShouldOverridesMinAndMaxPoolConfiguration_WhenBothConfigured
methods.description: Verifies if both min and max pool sizes are overridden when set.

methods.name: testCreateNewDataSourceFor_ShouldUseReadOnlyConfiguration_WhenInReadOnlyMode
methods.description: Tests creation of a read-only data source when in read-only mode.

methods.name: testCreateNewDataSourceFor_ShouldUseNormalConfiguration_WhenInBatchOnlyMode
methods.description: Tests creation of a normal, read-write data source when in batch-only mode.

methods.name: createModeProps
methods.description: Helper method to create mode property configurations for testing different modes.
